description: This source file implements classes related to Application Watchdog Container (AWC) state change notifications, including managing listeners, notifying state changes, and handling callbacks.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier
classes.description: Manages a list of listeners interested in AWC state changes and notifies them accordingly.

classes.name: AWCListener
classes.description: Receives notifications about window changes and app state changes, forwarding relevant info to the notifier.

methods.name: void addListener(AWCStateChangeListener * listener)
methods.description: Adds a listener to the notifier if it's not already registered.

methods.name: void removeListener(AWCStateChangeListener * listener)
methods.description: Removes a listener from the notifier's list.

methods.name: void notify(int req_id,awc::awc_app_state_t app_state,int status,unsigned int pid)
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of a state change.

methods.name: void notifyWindowChange(int window_id VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED,awc::AWCClient::awc_window_state_t window_state VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED,unsigned int pid VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED)
methods.description: Handles window state change notifications (empty implementation).

methods.name: void notifyStateChange(int req_id,awc::awc_app_state_t app_state,int status,unsigned int pid)
methods.description: Handles app state change notifications and forwards them to the notifier.

methods.name: void notifyServiceReady()
methods.description: Indicates the service is ready (no action taken).
